info.title: Beamfall Developer API
info.description: The Beamfall `/v1/` stable developer contract (ADR-0040). Every endpoint under `/v1/` is part of the stability promise: no breaking changes within this major version; a breaking change requires a new prefix (`/v2/`) with a minimum two-release deprecation window. Endpoints are authenticated with a scoped developer API key (`Authorization: Bearer bfk_...`) carrying a subset of the closed API-scope vocabulary; each operation declares the single scope it requires. All catalog and session reads are Reveal-filtered and Profile-bound to the key's binding (ADR-0004): a Profile-bound key never sees content or sessions outside its Profile, and restricted content it cannot Reveal never appears. The wire entity is `Media`; this surface is domain-agnostic (no plugin/domain vocabulary).

scopedKey.description: A scoped developer API key (ADR-0040 §2.2), minted by a server operator from the Console with a chosen scope subset and an optional Profile binding. Presented as `Authorization: Bearer bfk_...`. A session credential or an admin API token carries no API scopes and is rejected by every `/v1/` endpoint.

Library.description: A Reveal-filtered Library visible to the key's Profile binding.

restricted.description: True for a restricted Library (only present when the key has Revealed it).

MediaSummary.description: A Media item in a library feed. Generic, plugin-agnostic fields only.

MediaDetail.description: Full detail for one Media row, Reveal-filtered. A hidden or unknown id resolves to 404 (never an existence oracle).

Session.description: One active playback session. Media-identifying fields (mediaID/title/libraryID) are omitted when the key cannot currently see that Media under its Reveal filter.

PlaybackControlRequest.description: A closed-vocabulary transport command for one active playback session. Target and Media visibility failures all resolve to 404 to avoid session/Profile/restricted-Media oracles.

libraryID.description: The Library to scan. Must be visible to the key.

root.description: Optional root path. Empty scans the Library's persisted roots.

BackupStatus.description: Profile-bound backup ingest status for one Library. Paused is explicit so clients never silently drop uploads.

BackupMediaResponse.description: Result of a profile-owned backup upload registered as Media.

Forbidden.description: The scoped key does not carry the scope this operation requires.

get.summary: List the Libraries visible to the key.
get.description: Requires the `read-catalog` scope. Reveal-filtered and Profile-bound: a Profile-bound key sees only its Profile's granted Libraries, and a restricted Library it has not Revealed never appears.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Libraries to return.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

get.summary: List the Media in one Library.
get.description: Requires the `read-catalog` scope. Reveal-filtered: a Library outside the key's grants (or restricted and unrevealed) yields an empty list, never an error.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Media items to return.

200.description: The Media in the Library, Reveal-filtered.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

get.description: Requires the `read-catalog` scope. Reveal-filtered: a hidden or unknown id both resolve to 404, so the read is never an existence oracle for Media the key cannot see.

404.description: Media not found or not visible.

get.description: Requires the `read-sessions` scope. A Profile-bound key sees only its own Profile's sessions; an admin-scoped key (no Profile binding) sees all. Media-identifying fields are omitted for sessions playing Media the key cannot currently Reveal.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of active sessions to return.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

post.summary: Issue a transport command to an active playback session.
post.description: Requires the `playback-control` scope. Publishes one closed-vocabulary transport command (`pause`, `resume`, `skip-media`, `skip-track`) to the target session's event channel; success means the command was authorized and published, not that the target device has applied it. A Profile-bound key can control only its own Profile's reveal-visible active sessions. An admin-scoped key (no Profile binding) can control reveal-visible active sessions across Profiles, matching ADR-0040's operator-created all-session automation key model. Missing, cross-Profile, inactive, and reveal-hidden targets all resolve to 404.

202.description: The transport command was accepted for delivery.

400.description: sessionID missing, command missing or outside the closed transport vocabulary, or invalid JSON.

404.description: Session not found, not active, outside the key's Profile binding, or not reveal-visible.

post.description: Requires the `ingest` scope. Enqueues a durable scan job for a Library the key can see; an empty root scans the Library's persisted roots. A Library outside the key's grants is reported as 404 (never an existence oracle).

400.description: libraryID missing, the Library has no roots, or more than 200 roots require selecting one root.

get.summary: Read backup ingest status for one Library.
get.description: Requires the `backup` scope and a Profile-bound key. Returns the caller Profile's pause/quota state for the target Library; paused state is explicit so a client can surface that backup is stopped instead of silently dropping uploads.

500.description: Backup status could not be read due to an internal failure.

post.summary: Upload one profile-owned backup Media blob.
post.description: Requires the `backup` scope and a Profile-bound key. The request is multipart/form-data with `libraryID`, optional `title`, `class`, `container`, `codec`, and a `file` part. The server applies quota and disk-headroom checks, rejects hostile image headers for image uploads, encrypts the uploaded bytes before durable storage, and registers Media through the target Library catalog plane.

201.description: The upload was encrypted, deduplicated by content fingerprint, and registered as Media.

400.description: Invalid multipart request, missing fields, hostile image bytes, or rejected backup policy.

423.description: Backup ingest is paused and must be surfaced to the user.

500.description: Backup ingest failed due to an internal storage failure.

507.description: Quota or disk-headroom guard refused the upload.

get.summary: Subscribe to the server-sent event stream.
get.description: Requires the `events-subscribe` scope. A long-lived `text/event-stream` of Reveal-filtered server events (playback, library, and — for admin-scoped keys — Profile lifecycle). Event payloads carry only identifiers and state; a restricted-Media event never reaches a key that cannot Reveal it. This is an alias of the pre-existing `/api/events` route on the stable prefix; both resolve through the same `events-subscribe` gate. Reconnect with the standard `Last-Event-ID` header or the `?after=` query cursor.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume cursor: deliver only events after this sequence number.
